item.title: Human Consciousness & NHI: Are We Part of a Greater Intelligence? (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Val Jon Farris is an award-winning author, behaviorist, and internationally recognized leadership development expert who has spent more than four decades exploring the relationship between human consciousness, personal transformation, and professional excellence. Throughout his distinguished career, Farris has designed and delivered leadership programs to more than 40,000 executives, managers, and employees worldwide, working with major corporations including Microsoft, Hewlett-Packard, Intel, Yahoo, and organizations associated with Sir Richard Branson. His pioneering Transcendent Leadership and Leader of One SupraSelf programs combine self-awareness, spiritual development, and human potential to help individuals unlock higher levels of consciousness and personal achievement.

Farris's lifelong spiritual journey began at age 17, inspired by Paramahansa Yogananda, Kriya Yoga, and Buddhist teachings. Over the decades, he studied with influential spiritual teachers, including Swami Muktananda and Zen master Roshi Mumon Yamada, while also working alongside transformational thinkers Werner Erhard and Buckminster Fuller. These experiences shaped his unique approach to understanding consciousness, self-transcendence, and humanity's untapped potential. Today, Farris continues his work as an author, mentor, organizational development advisor, and advocate for expanding human awareness, exploring the deeper mysteries of consciousness and our place in the universe.

Spaced Out Radio is your nightly source for alternative information, starting at 9pm Pacific, 12am Eastern.  We broadcast LIVE every night.
